text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having heard a mock race was taking place, 
I came by to watch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among the runners warming up, 
honing her focus to a razor edge was... 
—KS Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the race started, she took the lead 
and surged ahead—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With every stride kicking the turf, her speed climbed steadily. 
Keeping the lead all the way, she crossed the line in 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Around the time the mock race concluded, 
I walked by the track once more. 
And there—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hahh... hahh...! 
—Gh, just... one more...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was it extra training? 
There was KS Miracle, still running. 
Could she be training right after a race...?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Phew... Just one more lap—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—? 
Um... Is something the matter?
choice_data_list: Didn't you just run in a race?
Didn't you just run in a race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The way she claimed 1st place at blazing speed 
was magnificent. But—that also meant 
it took a heavy toll on her body.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like before, with how hard she pushes herself, 
I wondered if she was resting properly...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...You were watching the race, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That makes me happy. 
...To know you care.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: No. I can still keep going.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Say, would you mind watching my run? 
The running powered by everyone's strength.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you watch... I'm sure 
you'll see that I'm completely fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping forward with light, rhythmic footfalls, 
her speed gradually began to build.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was right as that thought crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, —haah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her speed surged violently once more. 
—Her slender frame sliced through the wind like a blade.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without a shred of hesitation. Stride after stride, 
she kept accelerating, sprinting at full throttle. 
...As if burning away her very life.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hahh... hahh...—whew. 
...See, I was fine, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know what to say. 
That sharp, intense sprint 
was seared into my mind.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: How can I—you ask...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Truth is, 
I was never supposed to make it this far.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
When I was younger, my body was weak... 
I've even had experiences where I almost didn't survive.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yet every single time, everyone
worked miracles for me.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
They helped me, reached out their hands...
and allowed me to run again.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...So this time, it's my turn to bring about a miracle.
With these legs that everyone gave me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her tone carries an unshakeable strength of will.
Yet, considering the run I just witnessed...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san. I was fast, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...So, I'm alright.
choice_data_list: You should give your heart a rest once in a while.
You should give your body a rest once in a while.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: My heart...?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
There is that way of thinking too, isn't there?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still—I'm alright.
I will never waver. Absolutely not.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as she possesses this mindset,
she will likely keep running with every fiber of her being.
—Whether or not that is best for her is another matter.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But as I showed you just now,
my body is completely fine at the moment.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So... I'm alright. I won't cause anyone any trouble.
Neither to everyone else, nor to you.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. The sun was pretty strong today,
so make sure you stay well-hydrated, okay?
...Well then.
